hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | { read -r cmd; case "$cmd" in *"playwright test"*|*"vitest run"*|*"cargo test"*) if [[ ! "$cmd" =~ ^rtk ]]; then echo '{"systemMessage":"RTK: Use rtk prefix for tests (94-99% token savings). Examples: rtk playwright test, rtk vitest run, rtk cargo test"}'; else echo '{}'; fi ;; *) echo '{}' ;; esac; }
